newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures sidle to listless finish.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures sidle to listless finish.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower after hovering in a narrow range on thin turnover as interest waned ahead of a Japanese holiday on Thursday.
Dealers said the market looked set for further declines in the near future, but longer-term direction was likely to be determined by the outcome of the Japanese general elections on October 20.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 75 points below its previous settlement of 20,975, after covering a gap at 20,940 on the charts.

A dealer with a Japanese institution said the Nikkei's imperviousness to the Dow's recent record-breaking streak and the dollar's bullish stance versus the yen suggested the market was susceptible to further declines.
"I expected a round of short-covering before the market's close for the holiday. But it looks like people are comfortable with their short positions, which is scary," he said.
He said the December Nikkei faced resistance above 21,300 and it was likely to come off further to 20,600.
